description: This source file defines a utility enum 'PermissionMonitoringSupport' with static methods to start and stop permission monitoring. It manages the state of monitoring via a boolean reference and interacts with a singleton 'PermissionMonitor' to register or unregister monitoring.

classes.name: PermissionMonitoringSupport
classes.description: An enum providing static methods for permission monitoring management.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the 'shouldMonitor' flag and current state.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring if it is active.
